html.RM仍保留新人较大的年度变化空间，以及三个月的近期排位成绩均值半衰期。综合分包含: RM retains greater annual variation for less experienced drivers and a three-month half-life for the personal qualifying-result mean. It combines field-wide results with teammate evidence, rather than measuring same-car pace alone.
html.“两次均线”先在原RM分数上做两次后向均值，最后映射至6.5刻度。两个窗口可分别: Two-pass SMA applies both trailing averages to the original RM scores, then maps the result to the 6.5 scale. Set each window separately; defaults are 3/3 and 1 skips a pass. Each driver uses only their current and preceding saved snapshots. Short windows use the available points, year boundaries and zoom do not reset the calculation, and absences are not filled. The latest diamond also enters the smoothing. Smoothed display scores need not retain mean 6.5 and SD 2.
html.。本项目整理身份、重建历史信息边界并计算派生评分；这些分数不是F1DB原始输出，: . This project reconciles identities, reconstructs historical information cutoffs and calculates derived ratings. These ratings are not original F1DB outputs and do not imply its endorsement. This project is independent of F1 and the FIA.
html.以2010–2026 R14的逐站评分为参照。6.5代表历史中位水平，11.15: Referenced to driver-event ratings from 2010 through 2026 R14. The historical median maps to 6.5 and the top 1% threshold to about 11.15. Scores can exceed 10.
html.历史百分位映射 · 中心 6.5 · 标准差 2 · 不封顶: Historical percentile scale · Center 6.5 · SD 2 · No score cap
html.参考标尺在本文件中固定，筛选车手、年份或调整均线都不会重算百分位。相邻校准分数之: The reference scale is fixed in this file. Driver selection, year filters and SMA windows never recalibrate it. Between calibrated scores, monotone linear interpolation is used; outside the reference range, the nearest segment is extended. This is a retrospective display scale, not new information available to historical predictions. The underlying RM model and raw ordering are unchanged.

html.圆点为各站排位前的历史快照，不含该站排位结果；最新菱形含2026 R14结果，截: Circles are historical snapshots before each qualifying session and exclude that session’s result. The latest diamonds include 2026 R14, with a cutoff of 2026-09-25 11:00 UTC. Ratings come from event-by-event historical replay, not predictions recorded live at the time. This page does not update automatically.
html.圆点为各站赛前快照，菱形为最新 R14 后评分；缺席留空，虚线连接相邻赛季。: Circles: pre-qualifying snapshots. Diamonds: latest ratings after R14. Absences stay blank; dotted lines join consecutive seasons.
html.所选车手的评分变化折线图，数据也列在下方表格中: Rating history of the selected drivers. Raw scores are also shown in the table below.

html.拖拽框选 / 底部滑条缩放 · 双击还原: Drag to zoom / use the slider below · Double-click to reset
html.支持选择任意多人；包含现役、已退役车手和短期替补。: Compare any number of drivers, including current drivers, retired drivers and substitutes.
html.映射后的历史评分使用统一的6.5刻度：按2010–2026 R14的7,226个: Historical ratings share one 6.5 scale: percentiles of 7,226 raw pre-qualifying RM snapshots from 2010 through 2026 R14 are mapped to a normal distribution with mean 6.5 and SD 2. Ties stay tied, with no cap at 10. The 22 latest endpoints are not counted again in the reference sample.
html.曲线、列表和表格均使用新刻度。表格始终显示未平滑的映射分；悬停另列映射前RM分。: The chart, driver list and table all use the new scale. The table always shows unsmoothed mapped scores; hover also includes the original RM score. CSV exports include both scales, the SMA windows and the scale version for comparison.
html.请启用 JavaScript 以选择车手和显示曲线。: Enable JavaScript to choose drivers and display the chart.
html.选择“两次均线”后可调整；1 表示跳过该次。窗口越大越平滑，响应也越慢。: Select “Two-pass SMA” to adjust each window; 1 skips that pass. Larger windows are smoother but respond more slowly.
html.首次显示常用8位车手的2025–2026轨迹；可选择“全部”查看2010起历史，: The initial view shows the usual eight drivers in 2025–2026. Choose “All years” for history from 2010, or “ANT / RUS · 2026” for that pairing. Dotted lines mark parameter transitions between consecutive seasons; lines do not bridge absences. A driver’s last available snapshot is not a final post-retirement assessment.
html.F1 Quali · RM 评分图 · 仅展示已保存的评分，筛选和平滑不会改变模: F1 Quali · RM rating chart · Displays saved ratings; filtering and smoothing do not change the model.
html.RM是0.3.0的默认模型，m1r1保留可选。2017–2022为验证期，202: RM is the default model in 0.3.0; m1r1 remains optional. 2017–2022 is validation and 2023–2026 is already-seen replay. Greater rookie volatility and mixed predictive results remain limitations. A smoother curve does not mean a more accurate forecast.
html.2010–2015按赛事顺序回顾重建，日期不代表已核实的实际排位时刻。2010前: 2010–2015 is reconstructed retrospectively in event order; dates are not verified actual qualifying times. Pre-2010 results count only toward career experience, not rating observations. Early states start from a neutral prior. These curves are not an unconditional all-time ranking.
